Golf Apparel We Manufacture

Why Clubs and Brands Buy Golf Apparel Direct

Golf apparel carries one of the widest gaps between manufacturing cost and shelf price in all of clothing. A club polo that lands at a reasonable factory price routinely retails for four to five times that in the pro shop - and the club is usually buying through two intermediaries to get it.

Working factory-direct closes that gap and gives you control over the parts that matter: the exact pique weight, whether the collar is self-fabric or ribbed, where the logo sits and how it is digitised. Embroidery is done in-house on multi-head machines, so a club crest is stitched rather than heat-pressed. Test us first with a trial order, or browse the wider sportswear range.

Questions

What is the minimum order for custom golf polos?

50 pieces per design and colorway. Sizes can be mixed freely within that, and men's and women's cuts of the same design count toward the same minimum.

How much does a custom golf polo cost?

Quoted per design within 24 hours. Our published pricing page lists embroidered corporate polos from $13.00 at 50 pieces, falling with volume; golf-specific performance fabrics and extra decoration are itemised on the quote.

Do you embroider club crests and sponsor logos?

Yes - embroidery is done in-house on multi-head machines, including 3D puff, flat and appliqué. We digitise your artwork and send a stitch-out photo for approval before production.

Can you produce women's golf polos?

Yes. Women's shirts are cut from a properly graded women's pattern with a different shoulder, bust and hem shape, not a resized men's shirt, and use the same fabric and colorway as the men's run.

How long does a golf apparel order take?

Design mockup in 24-48 hours, sample in 5-7 business days, production 2-3 weeks, express DDP delivery 3-7 days.
